items.title: 14.5 Impact of human activities on the atmosphere

source_refs.note: Topic 14.5 as printed: the text before 14.5.1, printed page 311.

blocks.text: Human activities have significant impact on the atmosphere, primarily through the burning fossil fuels and deforestation. These activities contribute to climate change, air pollution, poor air quality and other environmental issues.

In urban areas, most air pollution comes from human-made sources. Such sources can be classified as either mobile (cars, trucks, air planes, marine engines) or point sources (factories, electric power plants etc.)
